devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: Phones, computers and servers that connect to the VPN.

summary.one: {online} of {n} device is online right now.
summary.other: {online} of {n} devices are online right now.

devices.empty_text: Add the first device and scan the QR code with the WireGuard app on the phone.

sched.label: Access hours
sched.tunnel: Can connect only during these hours
sched.internet: Can reach the internet only during these hours
sched.hint: If the end is before the start, the window crosses midnight (like 22:00–06:00). Times are the server's local time.
sched.hint_tz: If the end is before the start, the window crosses midnight (like 22:00–06:00). Times are the server's local time ({tz}).

add_dlg.title: New device
add_dlg.ip_hint: If left empty, the first free IP is assigned.
add_dlg.guest_hint: Set a duration for guests: when it ends the device is turned off, not deleted.
add_dlg.internet_hint: When on, all of the device's internet traffic goes through this server (the config is generated accordingly and the server allows it). When off, only the VPN network is used.

edit_dlg.title: Edit device · {name}
edit_dlg.policy_hint: Profile changes are applied to the firewall immediately; the device's config does not need to be refreshed.

regen.title: Regenerate · {name}
regen.intro_a: A new key is generated for the device.
regen.intro_c: ; the person must install the new one.
regen.internet_hint: The new config routes all internet traffic through the tunnel, and the permission on the server is set to match. To change only the server permission, use the Internet access permission switch on the card.

qr.title: QR code · {name}
qr.text: This device's QR code was shown once, when it was added. Kut does not store the private key, so it cannot produce the same code again.
qr.hint: For a new QR, generate a new key for the device. The old config stops working at that moment; the person must scan the new one.

config.title: Device configuration
config.no_qr: Could not generate a QR code; use the .conf file.
config.step1: Open the WireGuard app on the phone.
config.step2: Tap the + button and choose “Create from QR code”.
config.step3: Scan this code and turn the tunnel on.
config.touch_hint: If you are setting up this very device, you cannot scan a QR code: download the .conf file and choose “Import from file” in WireGuard.
config.notice: This configuration is shown only now. The private key is not stored on the server; if it is lost, “Regenerate” is needed.
config.copy_failed: Could not copy; select the text manually.

freeze.title: Freeze · {name}
freeze.text: When the time is up, the device comes back on its own.

inet.title: Internet access permission
inet.use_off: Off: the server does not forward internet traffic.
inet.use_idle: Allowed, but this device has not sent any internet traffic through the tunnel yet (it may be using only the VPN network).
inet.use_active: Allowed and in use: {bytes} forwarded, last traffic {ago}.
inet.use_stale: Allowed, not in use: last internet traffic {ago}.
inet.allow_text: The server starts forwarding internet traffic for “{name}”. This alone is not enough: if the device's config does not route all internet traffic through the tunnel, traffic still leaves through its own connection. To send all internet traffic through the tunnel, get a new config with “Regenerate”.
inet.block_text: The server immediately stops forwarding this device's internet traffic. If the device's config routes all internet traffic through the tunnel, the device cannot reach the internet; only the VPN network works. It stays this way until you regenerate the config.

delete_text.one: Permanently delete {n} device? Its connection is cut immediately and its profile rules are cleaned up.
delete_text.other: Permanently delete {n} devices? Their connections are cut immediately and their profile rules are cleaned up.

traffic.title: Traffic · {name}
traffic.hint: History is saved to disk (every 10 minutes and on shutdown); it is kept across service restarts. Long ranges are sampled sparsely.

delete.title: Delete device
delete.text: Permanently delete “{name}”? This device's connection is cut immediately and its profile rules are cleaned up.

tag.inet_on_title: The server forwards this device's internet traffic
tag.inet_off_title: The server does not forward this device's internet traffic
tag.guest_title: Guest device: turns itself off when the time is up
